usage: 秘魯 (Peru) is used as a proper noun to refer to the country in South America.
When talking about travel, you can say you are going to 秘魯 to indicate your destination.
In sentences, 秘魯 is usually the subject or object when discussing topics related to that country.
You can use 秘魯 with verbs like 去 (go), 來 (come), or 介紹 (introduce) when mentioning the country.
When asking about nationalities or origin, 秘魯 can be part of the answer, such as 我係秘魯人 (I am from Peru).
